text:
eve (Acme): hey, hitting 403 on POST /v1/embeddings/advanced since yesterday after we switched projects. says "Forbidden" but our keys worked earlier. any idea?

maya (Support): sorry you're blocked—can you paste the exact curl/headers (mask the key) and the error body if any? quick check: is this a new model name or endpoint?

eve (Acme): it's the same endpoint we used in prod for 2 months. curl: 
```

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings/advanced \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input": "test"}'

```
error body: `{"error":{"message":"Forbidden","code":"ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED"}}`

maya (Support): that code is useful — ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED usually indicates a plan/feature gating (not an auth token expiry). i'll double-check account entitlements. can you confirm your org id?

eve (Acme): org_58321

maya (Support): thanks — pinging @chris to look at request logs and entitlement checks.

chris (SRE): looking now. i can see the request at 2026-03-15T09:40:10Z. headers: 
```

Authorization: Bearer sk-***
User-Agent: acme-service/1.4
x-client-id: org_58321
```

and the service returned 403 with body matching `ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED`. stack trace shows check at service/entitlements.go: ValidateFeature("advanced_embeddings").

chris (SRE): short version: token is valid; request reached our edge and was routed, but the entitlement gate for "advanced_embeddings" failed. not an auth failure.

maya (Support): ok — that matches. @jonah can you confirm billing/plan for org_58321? might be on Starter which doesn't include advanced embeddings.

jonah (Billing): pulling up org_58321. current plan: Starter (legacy), billing_cycle next invoice 2026-04-01. No active add-ons. entitlement map shows: [basic_embeddings:true, advanced_embeddings:false]. so yeah gated.

eve (Acme): weird — we explicitly bought the advanced embeddings add-on last quarter. confirmation email shows upgrade submitted.

jonah (Billing): i see an upgrade request for org_58321 on 2025-12-17 but the payment method failed (card declined). there was an unpaid invoice that blocked the add-on activation. i can re-run the activation after payment. i'll DM billing ops to confirm.

maya (Support): two parallel paths: 1) quick prod unblock: we can temporarily flip entitlement for org_58321 to true as a manual override while billing resolves payment (audit log will record it). 2) preferred: finish billing flow so entitlement flips automatically. which do you want, @eve (Acme)?

eve (Acme): we need immediate unblocked traffic — option 1 please. but can you confirm this won't escalate my billing automatically? we need to sort PO internally first.

jonah (Billing): manual override won't charge anything automatically. it just toggles feature entitlements. but note: compliance requires a note with PO reference. please DM me the PO or we can apply a 7-day grace.

maya (Support): creating an override ticket. @chris can you apply a temporary entitlement toggle and set TTL 7d?

chris (SRE): yep — will add a feature override in admin-service: 
```

POST /admin/overrides 
{
  "org_id": "org_58321",
  "feature": "advanced_embeddings",
  "value": true,
  "expires_at": "2026-03-22T09:45:00Z",
  "reason": "Support: temporary unblock while customer resolves billing (ticket 45912)"
}

```

chris (SRE): applied. audit id: audit_7f3b. evoked cache invalidation across edge.

access-bot: entitlement-change: org_58321 advanced_embeddings=true by chris (SRE) at 2026-03-15T09:44:10Z audit=audit_7f3b

maya (Support): eve can you re-try the same curl now?

eve (Acme): retrying... works now! embedding returned 1536-d vector. thanks. :tada:

eve (Acme): any way to detect this earlier in our integration so we can show a clearer error? right now our app surfaces "Forbidden" which confused us.

maya (Support): good point — we should return more actionable error strings. i'll file a product bug: suggest mapping ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED to a 403 with body: `{"error":{"code":"ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED","message":"Feature \"advanced_embeddings\" not enabled for your plan. Visit /account/plan to upgrade or contact support."}}`

chris (SRE): also we can add a header `x-entitlement-reason: plan` or `x-entitlement-feature: advanced_embeddings` so clients can quickly route. low-risk change.

jonah (Billing): and on the billing side i'll trigger the retry for the failed payment and DM eve to collect PO info. will update ticket 45912.

maya (Support): summary for thread:
- root cause: entitlement gating (advanced_embeddings) due to unpaid upgrade, not an auth token issue. error code ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED.
- immediate remediation: manual entitlement override applied (expires 7d). audit=audit_7f3b.
- next steps: billing to retry payment / collect PO; add clearer error messaging + entitlement headers (product); consider auto-grace workflow for legacy customers.

eve (Acme): thanks team — appreciate the fast help. i'll follow up with billing DM.

maya (Support): marking this thread resolved for now. reopen if you see recurrence. :white_check_mark:
